announce.editedRegister: {{name}} edited at the classical register, column {{column}}.

comments.heading: Comments
comments.hint: Select a gate to comment on it, or write about the circuit as a whole. A resolved thread stays here, so "we discussed this and decided" is not lost.

anchor.orphaned: The gate this was about is no longer in this document

comments.orphanNotice_one: {{count}} thread below is about a gate that is no longer in this document. It is kept, because what was said still happened.
comments.orphanNotice_other: {{count}} threads below are about gates that are no longer in this document. They are kept, because what was said still happened.

empty.open: No open threads on this circuit.
empty.resolved: No resolved threads on this circuit.
empty.all: Nobody has commented on this circuit yet.

comments.full: This circuit has reached its limit of {{max}} threads. Resolve or delete one to start another.

compose.label: New comment
compose.hint: Up to {{max}} characters. Text between backticks is shown as notation.

thread.reveal: Show this gate on the canvas

announce.revealMissing: The gate this comment was about is not in this circuit.

ended.unauthorised: This circuit stopped being yours to open, so the shared session ended.
ended.overloaded: The shared session could not keep up with the changes and ended. Reopen the circuit to rejoin.
ended.gone: The shared session was let go. Reopen the circuit to rejoin.

session.readOnly: You are watching this session. Only the owner may edit.
session.invalid: The shared document reached a state this circuit cannot hold, so the session was let go.
